title: Shared first-layer background image and gradient geometry
scope: Shared origin/clip/size/signed-position/repeat geometry and bounded raster sampling; preserve existing non-background raster paths.
known_limits: First-layer representation; full multilayer backgrounds remain unsupported.
Existing radial/conic/gradient syntax and circular-radius approximations are not a full gradient/border implementation.
Fixed background attachment and broader special-element propagation remain outside this repair.

accepted_candidate.composition: Runtime121 plus exactly six geometry files; accepted flex123 and privacy124 deliberately excluded for attribution. Guarded launch required.

native_color_list.cases: order, short/extra lists, none layers, quoted/function commas, shorthand and CSS-wide inherit/initial/unset

gpu_antecedent122.scope: One real presented static bitmap test/reference pair and three internal own-reference cases on122; not a separate125 presentation run.

raster_resource_antecedent122.scope: Separate position-toggle diagnostic with restored inline value/priority; not unchanged WPT conformance or a broad performance claim.

rejected_attempts.result: 17/24 PASS, eight gains and one lost background-color-clip pass
rejected_attempts.diagnosis: Baseline test/reference both incorrectly used border-box.122 corrected the single-layer reference but kept the multilayer test incorrect; loss preserved.125 resolves bottom-image-layer clip list matching generally.

implementation_notes: One constant-size display item per background source; O(visible damage width) temporary sampling and no tile-count loops.
Shared CPU raster feeds software and default GPU presentation; tiled items excluded from image overlay bypass, tile metadata participates in item hashing.
Color clip is independently resolved from last image layer, including none, repeating/truncating clip lists after cascade; this does not implement multilayer image painting.
